_comment: per-map calibration for world->lat/lng projection. Units: origin_x/origin_y in degrees (world metres multiplied by scale), scale in degrees per metre, yaw_offset_deg in degrees added to the incoming yaw, yaw_sign is +1 or -1 multiplied into the incoming yaw. min_x/min_y/max_x/max_y are the world-metre extents used to derive a sensible default zoom. These MUST be calibrated per game version by matching two known in-game landmarks - see web/tiles/README.md.
_note: Any field absent here falls back to the hello.world values sent by the server over /ws, then to the defaults in radar.js (origin 0, scale 1e-5, yaw_offset_deg 0, yaw_sign +1). The shipped yaw knobs are IDENTITY because INTERFACES.md section 5 already defines the incoming yaw as '0 = north, clockwise positive'; set yaw_offset_deg = -90 and yaw_sign = -1 only for builds/levels that emit raw UE yaw.

_schema.origin_x: degree longitude offset in worldToLatLng: lng = origin_x + x * scale
_schema.origin_y: degree latitude offset in worldToLatLng: lat = origin_y + z * scale
_schema.scale: degrees per metre (both axes; the map is treated as an equirectangular patch)
_schema.yaw_offset_deg: added to UE yaw before drawing the heading arrow (the 3D rotation-correction knob #1)
_schema.yaw_sign: +1/-1 multiplier on raw UE yaw, for maps/protocol revisions where yaw runs counter-clockwise (knob #2)
